symptom: Belt slips or won’t move, but drive runs.

actions: Check capacity of conveyor and reduce load to recommended level.
Re-position take-up sheaves in hole closer to double groove sheaves.

causes.cause: Too much pressure against belt from pressure rollers
actions: Loosen spring tension on pressure rollers in area of stalled rollers. See “Minimum Pressure Adjustment” in Operation section of this manual.
